findings.spec_delta: Express the normal register observations separately at each continuation, retaining return/all RAM/firstfault.
findings.code_delta: Fresh SSA entry at every continuation, source identity and terminal mapping, independent instruction/expression read-before-write check, strict all-common-register fallback for unlisted Return tags.
findings.model_delta: Return-selected output equality and matching Rust witness observations; captured function value retained at every normal exit.
findings.current_machine_result: Reentered/unreachable continuations, sequential writes, lazy selects, address/return reads, tampered omissions and effect comparisons pass. Actual13-register source reproduces7/8/5 source-live slots plus the result capture.
findings.domain_wording: Values overwritten before any continuation use may be omitted from that exit interface. Fault register snapshots, guest PC, trace and instruction budget retain their separate contracts.
findings.epistemic_status: machine-confirmed under the declared source-bound observation contract

findings.spec_delta: Discover multiple expanded lanes and preserve invariant literals instead of hardcoding source roles or PC numbers.
findings.code_delta: Validated source SSA, bounded copy/trivial-phi normalization, captured-load kernels and multi-site anti-unification over exact literal sequences.
findings.model_delta: Proposal metadata only; source SSA identity, load sites and storage roles retained. Control/effect/alias equivalence is a subsequent validation gate.
findings.current_machine_result: Actual object through checked12-slot storage yields4 kernels and one3-lane group with offsets1/2/3; xor(i+1) stays invariant and the peeled direct-index load remains separate.384 concrete sequential-kernel comparisons include overlapping input/update memory.
findings.domain_wording: A discovered arithmetic family supplies a candidate body; the surrounding early exits and final-lane control still require their own source-bound correspondence.
findings.epistemic_status: machine-confirmed discovery and concrete template comparisons; no whole-function transformation claim

findings.spec_delta: Try exhaustive proof decomposition without narrowing inputs or discarding effects.
findings.code_delta: Guard the unchanged original query by normal/fault/return cases or1to4 low input bits. Share a capped total deadline across solver and SAT extraction; replay witnesses under the original observations.
findings.model_delta: Rust-generated guard coverage proved for all64-bit words/normal-status cases;34 single-case omissions make coverage SAT.

findings.domain_wording: Every case must be UNSAT before equivalence. A successful partial proof remains Unknown overall. Selector choice affects cost while the original domain and property stay fixed.

"""Replay a fixed development proposal with the archived source-bound inputs."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,hashlib,json,os,re,subprocess,sys

p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--out',required=True,type=Path)
p.add_argument('--mode',choices=['input','returns','address'],default='input')
p.add_argument('--checkpoint',default='tools/corpora/lane-patterns-v1.m2.json',type=Path)
a=p.parse_args();a.out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);a.out=a.out.resolve()
root=Path.cwd();record=json.loads(a.checkpoint.read_text())
base=json.loads(Path(record['baseline_checkpoint']).read_text())
sha=lambda data:hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
for name,digest in record['source_sha256'].items():
    assert sha(Path(name).read_bytes())==digest,name
for name,item in base['reproduction']['files'].items():
    assert sha(item['text'].encode())==item['sha256'],name
for name in ['source-ir.rs','source.ir']:(a.out/name).write_text(base['reproduction']['files'][name]['text'])
solver=Path(os.environ['NIRVANA_Z3']).resolve()
assert sha(solver.read_bytes())==record['tools']['z3_sha256']
pilot=record['reproduction']['files'][a.mode+'.rs']
assert sha(pilot['text'].encode())==pilot['sha256']
text=pilot['text'].replace('/home/hosi/nirvana/tests/support/',str(root/'tests/support')+'/')
text=text.replace('include!(concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/.git/nirvana-actual-loop-source.rs"));','include!(r#"'+str(a.out/'source-ir.rs')+'"#);')
text=text.replace('"target/checkpoints/ir-entry-storage-v1/printed-storage.ir.txt"','r#"'+str(a.out/'source.ir')+'"#')
path=a.out/'pilot.rs';path.write_text(text)
source=root/'tests/verification/region_extraction.rs';original=source.read_bytes()
try:
    source.write_bytes(original+('\n#[allow(dead_code)]\nmod archived_lane_trial { include!(r#"'+str(path)+'"#); }\n').encode())
    result=subprocess.run(['python3','tools/dev.py','cargo','test','--test','verification','exit_specific_loop_candidate_pilot','--','--ignored','--nocapture','--test-threads=1'],env=os.environ|{'NIRVANA_Z3':str(solver),'NIRVANA_LOOP_OUT':str(a.out)},capture_output=True,text=True)
finally:source.write_bytes(original)
log=result.stdout+result.stderr;(a.out/'run.log').write_text(log)
assert source.read_bytes()==original
assert result.returncode==0,log
expected=record['trials'][a.mode][0]
for name in ['compare-false.smt2','compare-true.smt2','complete-false.smt2','complete-true.smt2','candidate.c']:
    assert sha((a.out/name).read_bytes())==expected['artifacts'][name]['sha256'],name
for optimization in ['-O0','-O2']:
    assert f'opt={optimization} cases=325 full_ram=true faults=true ubsan=true' in log,log
positive=re.search(r'wrong=false completion=complete .*compare=(\w+)',log).group(1)
negative=re.search(r'wrong=true completion=complete .*compare=(\w+)',log).group(1)
report={'mode':a.mode,'source_restored':True,'query_and_c_hashes_match':True,'generated_c_cases':650,'positive':positive,'negative':negative,'proof_reproduced':positive=='equivalent' and negative=='counterexample_replayed','log_sha256':sha(log.encode())}
if 'NIRVANA_CLANG18' in os.environ:
    sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tools'))
    from evaluation import control_graph as cg
    result_cfg=subprocess.run([os.environ['NIRVANA_CLANG18'],'--analyze','-std=c11','-Werror','-Xclang','-analyzer-checker=debug.DumpCFG',str(a.out/'candidate.c'),'-o',os.devnull],capture_output=True,text=True)
    assert result_cfg.returncode==0,result_cfg.stderr
    raw,stats=cg.parse_dump(result_cfg.stderr,'nirvana_readable');graph,_=cg.normalize(raw)
    source_graph=cg.graph_from_json(json.loads(base['reproduction']['files']['source-cfg.json']['text'])['graph'])
    distance=cg.distance(source_graph,graph,max_states=100000,seconds=1.0)
    assert distance['status']=='exact' and distance['upper_bound']==13 and stats['gotos']==7
    report['quality']={'distance':13,'gotos':7}
(a.out/'replay.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
if negative!='counterexample_replayed' or (a.mode=='input' and positive!='equivalent'):raise SystemExit(2)
